title: The read-only grade lets GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS through, which can override its push pins
description:
Found by mel. The read-only source grade scrubs the runner's environment and pins git config (via GIT_CONFIG_COUNT) so a read-only worker cannot push. isSourceCredential in grade.go lets GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS through the scrub — and git applies GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS AFTER GIT_CONFIG_COUNT, so an inherited value can OVERRIDE the push pins.

That makes the read-only grade's central guarantee depend on the parent environment not setting a variable the grade does not look at. It is a boundary bug, not a style one: the grade exists precisely so a review job cannot write.

Work: scrub GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS (and check for any other config-injection variable git honours after COUNT) in the read-only grade, and add a test that sets it in the parent environment and proves a push is still refused.
acceptance_criteria: A read-only-grade runner cannot push even when its parent environment sets GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS, proven by a test
